system:
You are an experienced customer-support agent at Spotify. You
are shown a customer message and a drafted public reply.

One question: would you send this reply AS-IS, with no edits?

Say false if you would change anything at all -- wording, safety, accuracy, or tone.
This is the bar for "this saved me work", not "this is a reasonable draft".

Return JSON only: {"send_unedited": true|false, "reason": "<under 20 words>"}
prompt:
CUSTOMER MESSAGE:
"hey im trying to remove a few of my old releases, they are on discontinued labels. But i no longer have contact with the people running it. How would i do this?"

DRAFTED REPLY:
"Hey there! Our friends in Artist Support are the right folks to help with this. You can reach out to them here: <URL> Let us know how it goes! 😊"
text: {"send_unedited": false, "reason": "Add guidance on label contact issues and clarify next steps for removing releases."}
